new_checks: 12 checks: original six unchanged, plus all-height footprint, height bounds, per-wall20cm and max gap, upper-strip20cm and max gap.
rationale: 35cm footprint margin covers measured trim and simplified reference differences; additional per-wall and top-strip 20cm coverage>=99.5% and max gap<=25cm use existing tolerances. Upper strip is collision-wall observation support, not a surveyed mesh.
adaptive_mapping: Top support inferred solely from neighboring live measured height bins with at least 3 points, up to 1m neighborhood, targets .3..3.0m; reference model remains offline only.
observation_los_endpoint: Only known occupied cells within 0.20m of observation target are transparent in temporary visibility mask; unknown and navigation masks unchanged.
